# Risk and Compliance Audit Findings and Updates

This memo outlines several key actions required for the Risk & Compliance department:

*   Update legal risks based on recent audit findings.
*   Update internal controls based on recent audit findings.
*   Review the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) detection standard updates.
*   Urgently investigate the current internal control framework.
*   Conduct quarterly reviews of regulatory changes to ensure ongoing compliance.
